forces: palmate — kit mileage (shared maple parts) + the leaf.face hero (strong silver underside)
descriptor: Fast, broad-spreading maple; deeply-cut palmate leaves flashing silver-white below; pale-yellow fall; shaggy reddish-grey peeling bark.
identityNotes: Deeply cut, sharply pointed lobes with very deep U-sinuses and a VIVID silvery-white underside — the whole canopy flashes silver in wind (the defining trait). Often weak-wooded, ascending-then-arching limbs.

referenceImages.caption: Broad spreading crown; deeply lobed leaves with silver undersides catching light.
Pale yellow autumn foliage (less vivid than sugar/red maple).
Mature shaggy grey-to-reddish-brown peeling bark strips.

leaf.face.note: THE leaf.face case — bright silvery-white underside

overlay.type.note: large paired samaras, the biggest of native maples

leaf.note: kit-mileage: shares the palmate pack with sugar/red maple

provenance.notes: New dossier. Kit-mileage proof — re-uses the palmate pack. The leaf.face axis is load-bearing here (strong two-tone).
